cost.title: Cost caps
cost.hint: Caps are enforced live: a built-in assistant call is blocked before it runs the model when its domain or the tenant is at/over cap (checked against reconciled LiteLLM spend). Live spend lives in the Monitoring tab; self-hosted models report $0/token, so a cap bites once real spend approaches its ceiling.
